description: A team of developers building innovative applications for the Rio Grande Valley. We focus on full-stack development and creating practical solutions to everyday problems.
We combine different programming skills to develop creative solutions for local businesses. Our goal is to build useful applications while learning new technologies.
A one-man development team determined to conquer the hackathon. Armed with Python, C++, Java, and an unreasonable amount of confidence, Jorge is ready to take on the competition.
